ImageDescription.value:
Photo of August 29, 1998 visit of Navy Chief of Chaplains Rear Admiral Byron Holderby to Israel's John F. Kennedy Memorial (Yad Kennedy) to plant trees at the Kennedy Peace Forest. Pictured in photo, left to right are:

USN Chaplain (Captain) Thomas Giuntoli, then chaplain for U.S. Navy Europe; Rabbi (chaplain) Irving Elson, visiting Israel to speak about the role of chaplains to U.S. rabbinical students studying in Israel; Mr. Avi Dickstein, Director of Resource Development and Public Affairs, Keren Kayemet LeYisrael-Jewish National Fund; United States Chief of Navy Chaplains Rear Admiral Byron Holderby; and Rabbi (chaplain) Arnold E. Resnicoff, then Command Chaplain for the U.S. European Command, who arranged and coordinated Chaplain Holderby's visit.

ImageDescription.value: One of 51 concrete columns on Yad Kennedy, the John F. Kennedy Memorial in Israel (outside of Jerusalem).
